title: MVCC revisions of staged inputs / MVCC-Revisionen bereitgestellter Eingaben
$comment: 🧊️ RevisionV1: an immutable, content-addressed snapshot of exactly the input closure of a build. Canonical JSON (the bytes that are hashed): UTF-8, object keys sorted by code point, no whitespace, no ASCII escaping. A tree object is canonical({entries:[{digest,kind,name,size}...]}) with entries sorted by name code point; its digest is sha256 of those bytes and it is stored in the content-addressed store under that digest. A directory entry has kind tree, a file kind file or executable (executable only where the platform has an exec bit), a link kind symlink whose digest is that of its target text. The size of a tree is the sum of its entries. A revision object is canonical({journalCursor,parent?,roots,workspace}); its id is the sha256 of those bytes, so a revision is itself a store address. An action key is sha256(canonical({command,environment,manifest,tool})) and contains no workspace, no absolute path and no time, so equal inputs share results in every workspace.

path.$comment: Workspace-relative prefix the tree is rooted at; empty is the workspace root.

digest.$comment: Root tree digest: equal inputs have an equal digest in every workspace.

torn.en: {path} kept changing while it was staged; the revision records the content that was read.
torn.de: {path} hat sich während der Bereitstellung laufend geändert; die Revision hält den gelesenen Inhalt fest.

absent.en: {path} does not exist at this revision.

pinned.en: Revision {revision} pinned: {files} files, {reused} reused, {staged} staged, {torn} torn.
pinned.de: Revision {revision} gepinnt: {files} Dateien, {reused} wiederverwendet, {staged} bereitgestellt, {torn} unruhig.

unsafe-path.en: The path {path} is not a safe relative path.
unsafe-path.de: Der Pfad {path} ist kein sicherer relativer Pfad.

content-evicted.en: The content of {path} left the store and the workspace no longer holds it; pin the revision again.
content-evicted.de: Der Inhalt von {path} ist aus dem Speicher verschwunden und im Arbeitsbereich nicht mehr vorhanden; die Revision neu pinnen.

unknown-revision.en: The revision {revision} is not in the store.
unknown-revision.de: Die Revision {revision} ist nicht im Speicher.

unsupported-entry.en: {path} is neither a file nor a symbolic link.
unsupported-entry.de: {path} ist weder eine Datei noch ein symbolischer Link.

invalid-revision.en: The object {revision} is not a valid revision.
invalid-revision.de: Das Objekt {revision} ist keine gültige Revision.
